Mexico City's skyline is dominated by corporate headquarters and financial institutions with neon holographic ads promoting debt consolidation services in the air. Navigating digital debt management apps or securing loans through them determines economic survival. Harried workers fill tense streets.

An authoritarian state maintains a heavy presence, patrolling corners and hovering overhead to remind citizens of no tolerance for dissent. Nature has seemingly abandoned this city; barren trees and water rationing are constant reminders of environmental collapse amidst the smog-obscured sky. This scenario showcases Mexico City where four axes—authoritarian state, social conflict, capitalist hegemony, and environmental collapse—all converge creating daily life challenges.
